parsed.name: 函数发生器
parsed.description: 函数发生器是一种电子测试仪器，用于产生可调频率、幅度、相位、直流偏置和波形类型的电信号。它常用于电子电路测试、传感器与执行器激励、教学实验以及通用信号源应用。
parsed.description_en: A function generator is an electronic test instrument that produces electrical signals with adjustable frequency, amplitude, phase, DC offset, and waveform type. It is commonly used for circuit testing, sensor and actuator excitation, teaching labs, and general-purpose signal source applications.
